entities.name: José Manuel Beirán

entities.summary: José Manuel Beirán Lozano is a former Spanish basketball player with Real Madrid Baloncesto of the Liga ACB. He was born in León. He also played for Spain at the 1984 Summer Olympics, where he scored 8 points in 4 appearances. Spain won a silver medal in the games.
